resources.string: Costly identity
Back
A burn sends XMR to an address whose keys nobody holds. The money is gone: nothing comes back, and nobody can undo it.
What you get is a proof that this name, and no other, gave up that much. You show it to someone deciding whether to deal with you, and their own node checks it. Nothing is published.

Where it goes
Both keys of this address are hashes of a published string, so anyone can work it out for themselves and see that nobody chose a secret. What arrives here can never be spent.
